quality_gate.numeric_promotion_policy: Measured promotion requires direct parse/readback from an authoritative official facility-level annual numeric dataset. The EEA July 2026 listing and distribution identity remain verified, but the actual facility-level downloadable asset was not successfully downloaded or parsed, so Part43 annual values remain candidate-only.
quality_gate.candidate_confidence_rule: 99 requires official UK installation identity plus target-period legal/operator continuity and a uniquely attributable EUTL annual series.
quality_gate.immingham_resolution: Official UK NIM identifies GB-EA-ETCO2-0027 / Immingham CHP LLP / Immingham CHP. Environment Agency permits preserve the Immingham CHP Power Plant identity through the target period and Companies House records the same LLP legal entity under the later VPI Immingham LLP name. Power-Station-Dictionary uniquely maps the station to EUTL 96880.
quality_gate.cowes_resolution: Official UK NIM identifies GB-EA-ETCO2-0150 / RWE Npower Plc / Cowes GT Power Station. Elexon target-period records identify RWE Generation UK plc with Cowes Power Station BM Units E_COWE1/E_COWE2, matching the Power-Station-Dictionary object and unique EUTL 97160 series.
